An extortion group claimed to publish material linked to the vendor.
open_questions: What data was taken, and how many people were affected?
mitigations: Audit what data advertising vendors receive and retain.
Review vendor access, retention, and incident-notification controls.

Lighter post-mortem on trader API-key co.summary: Lighter attributed the compromise to external signing software used by a trader and said its protocol was unaffected. The exchange reported returning about $5 million USDC; that is a partial recovery, not a new loss.

Unauthorized transfers led Lighter to pause withdrawals.
Lighter reported a partial recovery and reopened withdrawals.
open_questions: What amount remains unrecovered?

Limit API key permissions and alert on unusual transfers.

Gonka confirms bridge incident and repor.summary: Gonka confirmed a security incident affecting its Ethereum bridge. It reported that the funds were fully returned.

Test pause and recovery procedures before reopening bridge service.

ZOZO confirms ZOZOTOWN and WEAR customer.summary: ZOZO reported exposure of member data through PLAID’s KARTE marketing platform. It gave separate counts of about 15.18 million ZOZOTOWN members and 13.93 million WEAR members, with overlap unknown.

Equinor cyberattack linked to Azure API.summary: Norway’s National Security Authority said attackers exploited Microsoft Azure API Management against Equinor and other organisations. The authority said the flaw was fixed; Equinor said it stopped the intrusion and reported no indication of stolen data or production impact.
attack_chain: The regulator attributed the intrusion to a vulnerability in a managed Azure service.
Equinor detected unauthorized activity on November 17 and mobilized its response teams.
Equinor announced containment on November 20; Norway’s regulator said the flaw had been fixed.

What evidence is available to customers to determine whether their own environments were reached?

Preserve Azure activity, identity and gateway logs and investigate anomalous management actions.

Peach Aviation discloses Cuenote vendor.summary: Peach Aviation reported 8,997,106 affected customer records after a breach at email vendor Yumirulink. The count does not establish unique individuals, and the airline said passport and payment-card information was not affected.

Unauthorized access occurred at the service provider on October 18; Peach later confirmed the scope of its affected records.

How many unique people do the records represent?

Review vendor access and audit logs, and conduct joint incident response exercises.
Direct customers to verified company channels and warn about breach-themed impersonation.

Microsoft Agent Framework PyPI supply-ch.summary: Two unauthorized Microsoft Agent Framework package versions exposed developer credentials and were removed from PyPI. Wiz reported three confirmed cases of data theft and said the attacker appears to have used compromised credentials for Microsoft’s release pipeline. How the pipeline credentials were obtained remains unknown.
attack_chain: Researchers suspect release-pipeline credentials were compromised.
Unauthorized PyPI releases exposed developer credentials before being removed.
open_questions: How were the release credentials obtained?
What is the full scope of downstream exposure?
mitigations: Inventory package versions in builds and deployed environments; remove the affected releases and use a vendor-approved version.
Rotate affected secrets, review sign-in and CI logs, and rebuild runners or images from trusted sources.

Binance CEX.summary: Binance reported roughly $6.3 billion stolen in the October 29 incident. It obtained court orders to help recover assets, and blockchain monitors reported additional movements of funds attributed to the theft; these are developments in the original case, not a new loss.
attack_chain: Binance’s preliminary findings describe social engineering and compromise of employee devices.
Binance said the attacker misused an internal tool and gained unauthorized access to wallet signing operations.
Binance reported unauthorized transfers, then said it rebuilt the affected wallet environment, replaced devices and retired compromised credentials.
open_questions: How much has been returned, rather than frozen or tracked?
Which residual controls and assets remain subject to the investigation?
mitigations: Isolate wallet signing from employee devices and general-purpose internal tools.
Require independently verified approvals for large transfers and monitor changes to privileged access.
Keep recovery communications and coordination procedures ready with custodians and issuers.

European Commission Confirms AI-Assisted.summary: The European Commission said an AI-assisted cyberattack detected in October led it to take several internal applications offline as a precaution. The Commission confirmed an AI-assisted campaign but has not publicly established its full scope.
The Commission took several applications offline as a precaution and restored most of them.

How did the campaign start and what remains offline?
Did it affect data or people outside the group covered by the Commission’s statement?
mitigations: Separate access to HR and reimbursement applications and require phishing-resistant authentication for privileged accounts.
Preserve application and identity logs and review for unusual access or bulk reads.
Test restoration from known-good backups and rehearse alternate workflows for essential internal services.

K3 Capital.summary: K3 Capital said roughly 3.43 million BOLD drained from its sBOLD vault on November 18 and traced the loss to the vault’s handling of collateral swaps. The project paused the vault and began pursuing partial recovery; it said Liquity V2 was not affected.

The flawed workflow was abused to draw assets from the vault.

open_questions: How much will be returned to depositors?
What controls will be audited before the vault is used again?
mitigations: Verify swap results against observed asset balances and clear unused approvals.
Test with adversarial token and router behavior; add invariant tests for assets and shares.
Set abnormal outflow alerts and rehearse pausing affected vault operations.

Alleged hosting intrusion and Trubank ex.summary: VECERT Analyzer relayed a claim that a multi-tenant hosting environment and a system attributed to Trubank were accessed. Coinbase India INR withdrawal outage.summary: Coinbase India attributed unavailable in-app rupee withdrawals to an outage at its banking partner and said payouts were being processed in batches. What caused the partner payout outage and how many users experienced delays?

Test failover and duplicate-payment protection before rerouting payouts.
Publish status and support guidance through verified channels to reduce impersonation risk.

Minimize retention of sensitive demographic data and limit access to exam results.

Fluidkey.summary: Bitquery traced at least $1.58 million in unauthorized payouts across six chains. Fluidkey attributed the incident to exposed session data involving a third-party logging tool and restored service on an updated app. It says user keys remained on their devices; a full post-mortem is pending.

Rate-limit and anomaly-check relayer submissions per account

Wagyu (XMR1).summary: XMR1, Wagyu's bridged Monero token on Hyperliquid, fell from about $500 to $1 after roughly $13.5 million in sales. mitigations: Keep deployer and mint keys in HSM or multisig, never on hosting infrastructure
Remove or time-lock mint authority after deployment
Alert on mints and large sells from privileged addresses
